thesis: The episode serves as a conversational tribute to David Swensen, reflecting on his character, leadership style, and the rigorous demands of his role at Yale University's Investment Committee. It recounts how the host was invited to join the committee based on a shared professional philosophy that prioritizes the profession of investing over the business, while highlighting the intense preparation required for meetings involving thick, double-sided documents.
